title: Dark Trading and Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift
authors: Jacob K. Kandathil Thomas; Frank Zhang; Wei Zhu
eligible_reason: SEC Tick Size Pilot randomized design with phase-in during October 2016 only (Post_start = each ticker's pilot effective date, controls set to 2016-10-03; Code_pilot_list.sas lines 754-775). Code_tables.do compares test group G3 (trade-at) with G2: reghdfe y test_g3 post test_g3_post, absorb(ticker date), where post switches on for both groups, i.e. an extra treatment regressor. The main PEAD tests interact the earnings surprise with test_g3 x post (triple difference with continuous sue_ret/fe, firm- and quarter-specific slopes) and add firm controls; the representative-sample analyses use OLS with continuous dark-trading share and 2SLS. Not a staggered binary TWFE design.
design_notes: SAS processing of TAQ/CRSP/Compustat/IBES; Stata reghdfe/ivreghdfe in Code_tables.do. Daily stock-level DiD of dark trading on the pilot (Table 2 style), quarterly PEAD regressions with sue_ret interactions, OLS and 2SLS on the Compustat/CRSP sample.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Pilot effective dates fall within October 2016 (weekly phase-in); quarterly PEAD analyses treat it as one event.
data_files_note: Readme.docx: CRSP, IBES, TAQ, Compustat, OptionMetrics, 13F licensed via WRDS; package ships SAS and Stata code only.
software_notes: SAS for data construction, Stata for regressions
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Policy RCT phased in within one month plus continuous-treatment PEAD and IV analyses; licensed data not shipped.
